releasenotes: Profile fields next to posts: IPS selected the list of profile fields once for every post author on a page, and in archived topics also each author's values one by one. The list is now read once per request and the values of the page's authors with one query; IPS's own code still decides who sees which field. About 9 ms per topic page; for a guest, an archived topic with 16 authors: 50 -> 20 queries. Separate switch in the settings.
